'''Honest Tobar's Used Spacecraft''' was a [[Starship/Legends|spaceship]] shop run by [[Tobar]] and located in the port of [[Zallakesh|Zellakesh]] on [[Chuzalla]].

==History==
The shop sold the acclaimed [[Blackhawk Destroyer]], a starfighter-sized personal spacecraft. [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Coby]] of [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]] bought such a craft from Tobar while chasing a [[Starhunter menagerie ark]].
